uncertain_points.claim: Mux6SelWidth enum values (MUX6_SEL_0..5) use non-standard 6-bit patterns (e.g., 6'b011101) with no documented justification.
uncertain_points.risk: Unclear security/sparse-encoding intent may lead to unintended behavior if these values feed mux selects without extra protection.

uncertain_points.claim: The CTRL_RESET parameter definition is cut off after `'{`, leaving the reset value for ctrl_reg_t fields (manual_operation, key_len, mode, operation, etc.) undefined in this chunk.
uncertain_points.risk: Undefined reset value for a control register may cause unpredictable initial AES configuration, potentially enabling unauthorized operations or key exposure.
